Karen — thanks for the PO and context. Quick proposal below; attaching a reconciliation workbook and a VAT mapping sheet for the country breakdown.

Summary proposal (high level):
- Invoice approach: monthly consolidated invoices that sweep against the committed prepay balance. Each invoice will include a line for token consumption and a separate line for reserved capacity (if used).
- Drawdown cadence: monthly on the 1st of the month (first practical invoice will be 2027-06-01) with a near-real-time usage export for your AR team.
- Accounting treatment: Redwood will issue an "Advance Receipt"/prepaid invoice. For your GL, this can be posted to a Prepaid Expenses or Customer Deposit account — Karthik, please confirm recommended GL code.
- VAT: we will include VAT summary per legal entity (USD/EU/ROW) on every consolidated invoice and provide a separate VAT matrix (attached) that ties back to each line item and country of consumption.

Attachments: VAT-Matrix-USD-EU-ROW.xlsx; 20270516-invoice-sweep-ops.docx

Next steps / asks:
1) Karen: confirm the AR contact and the exact VAT ID to print on the EU invoice (I attached a placeholder from your PO).
2) ProcurePoint: can you confirm payment instructions and when you typically run the ACH sweep after invoice receipt?
3) Stephanie/Karthik: if we agree the GL treatment, I will update the invoice descriptors and the monthly memo so Skyline's treasury has a clean audit trail.

If that timeline works we'll circulate a one-page mutual action plan and a sample invoice template for sign-off.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: VAT-Matrix-USD-EU-ROW.xlsx (spreadsheet), 20270516-invoice-sweep-ops.docx (ops checklist)

  * Karen: confirm EU VAT ID to print on invoice and AR contact (reply to this thread).

  * Stephanie: route EU compliance packet to k.lee@skyline.ai and confirm any required invoice headers.
  * Karthik: share GL code memo and the amortization CSV by Thursday morning.
